title: Tensor counit square for one ordered affine line
statement: For a finite commutative ring A annihilated by N, a scheme S with N invertible, normalized twist transport t, and projective-line datum D [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-data], the actual affine-line open/projective composite counit [def-amb-affine-trace-construction] commutes with lineAction and lineStrength [def-pur-ordinary-affine-tensor-actions] for every pair of unbounded coefficient inputs H,K.

source.place: last paragraph: projection formula on chosen compactifications and the ordered affine-line tower; categorical calculations making coefficient normalization explicit

proof.text:
apply the open counit tensor identity at the projective-line right functor.
Paste this square with ordinaryFiniteP1Counit_tensorAction. Naturality of the open
counit moves the projective strength through it. Naturality of the proper projection
then combines the two squares into the composite counit. This is exactly the
specified lineStrength and lineActionNat, so no normalization is replaced.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryAffineLine_tensorCounit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (D : OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t S hS)
    (H K : DerivedCategoryModule A S) :
    (lineActionNat A S H).app ((affineTraceLineRight A N hA S).obj K) ≫
      (affineTraceLineLeft A S).map (lineStrength A N hA S H K).hom ≫
      (affineTraceLineAdjunction A N hA t S hS D).counit.app
        (((ordinaryFiniteTensor A S).obj H).obj K) =
      ((ordinaryFiniteTensor A S).obj H).map
        ((affineTraceLineAdjunction A N hA t S hS D).counit.app K)
